sources.authority_or_licence: TraceX synthetic demonstration specification; not official SIH material.

sources.authority_or_licence: National Technical Research Organisation (NTRO), Smart India Hackathon 2026
sources.labels: None provided by the PS; evaluation uses TraceX's own seed-controlled synthetic ground truth.
sources.time_meanings: PS lists a 'timestamp' field only; TraceX keeps block time and observer time distinct.
sources.content: SIH 2026 PS 26146 (Problem Statement 5, NTRO): 'AI-Powered Monitoring & Analysis of Bitcoin Transaction Traffic'. The linked Drive item is the problem-statement document itself, not a dataset.
sources.dataset_statement: 'Participants will work with a synthetic dataset modelled on real Bitcoin P2P/transaction fields (no real seized or live-intercept data will be provided).' Dataset Link: Nil.
sources.geoip_requirement: integrate an open-source downloadable Geo-IP database (see app/engine/geoip.py)
sources.intake_procedure: Any dataset supplied at the event is checked with `tracex-dataset inspect FILE --full --register` (SHA-256, record count, PS field coverage, normalisation trial) before import; header spellings are mapped by app/engine/canonical/profiles.py.
